api_key_env.title: Environent variable name for API Key
api_key_env.description: Environment variable which stores the api key

api_key_file.title: API Key file
api_key_file.description: Filepath to plain text file containing the API Key

operator_database_file.title: Operator Database File
operator_database_file.description: Filepath to existing operators XML file, can be xml or compressed (GZ). If the file does not exist, it will be created at this location

operator_database_url.title: Operator Database URL
operator_database_url.description: URL to XML file containing Operators data

operator_database_encoding.title: Operator Database Encoding
operator_database_encoding.description: Encoding of the Operators XML database

stop_database_file.title: Stop database filepath (CSV or GZ)
stop_database_file.description: Filepath to Stop database file, can be CSV or compressed CSV (GZ). If file does not exist it will be created at this location.

stop_database_url.title: Stop database URL
stop_database_url.description: URL to fetch Stop database from when stop file cannot be found

stop_database_encoding.title: Stop database encoding
stop_database_encoding.description: Encoding of the Stop CSV database

database_file.title: Database Filepath
database_file.description: Path to the database file, if one is not present a new version will be initialised at the specified location.

reinitialise.title: Reinitialise database
reinitialise.description: Reinitialise the database regardless of whether it already exists at the specified file path.
